interface.Baking, press Esc to cancel: 正在烘焙，按 Esc 取消
interface.Baking frame {done} of {total}, press Es: 正在烘焙第 {done} / {total} 帧，按 Esc 取消
interface.Bake cancelled; the scene was restored: 已取消烘焙，场景已恢复
interface.Baked {frames} frames for {count} shards: 已为 {count} 块碎块烘焙 {frames} 帧，用时 {seconds:.1f} 秒，其中 {moved} 块发生了运动
interface.({count} start frames were moved to the: （{count} 个起动帧早于起始帧之后的第一帧，已推迟到该帧）
interface.Reset {count} shards to their rest pose: 已把 {count} 块碎块恢复到静止姿态
interface.Settings changed since the last bake: 设置在上次烘焙后改过
interface.{current} of {count} assets have current: {count} 个资产中有 {current} 个模拟输入未变
interface.End Frame must be after Start Frame: 结束帧必须晚于起始帧
interface.Shard \"{name}\" has its own animation;: 碎块“{name}”带有自己的动画，请先清除再模拟
interface.({count} starts were held back by frozen: （{count} 次起动被冻结或固定的物体挡住；改用休眠可以让撞击继续传递）
interface.(Substeps raised to {count} for final qu: （为达到终稿质量，每帧子步已提高到 {count}）
interface.(The suggested substeps are above the li: （建议的每帧子步超过上限 {count}，很快的碎块仍可能穿过薄的碎块）
interface.Set Quality to Final to use it: 把质量设为终稿即可采用
interface.{count} other assets are moved out of th: 烘焙期间有 {count} 个其他资产会临时移出刚体世界
interface.{assets} assets and {bodies} other rigid: {assets} 个资产与 {bodies} 个其他刚体一起参与
interface.Shard \"{name}\" has a parent; unparent: 碎块“{name}”有父级，请先解除父级再模拟

tooltips.Simulate fractured assets with their dri: 让破碎资产在驱动作用下进行模拟，并烘焙出运动
tooltips.Simulate the selected assets together an: 把所选资产放在一起模拟，并把运动烘焙成关键帧；按 Esc 可取消并恢复场景
tooltips.Delete the baked motion of the selected: 删除所选资产烘焙出的运动，并把碎块放回静止姿态
tooltips.Bake from the start to the end frame of: 从场景的起始帧烘焙到结束帧；关闭后可在这里自行设置范围。
tooltips.First frame of the simulation; shards ar: 模拟的第一帧；碎块在这一帧处于静止姿态。
tooltips.Simulation steps per frame; more steps k: 每帧的模拟步数；步数越多，快速或很薄的碎块越不容易相互穿过，但耗时更长。
tooltips.Iterations per step for resolving contac: 每步求解接触的迭代次数；越多，堆叠的碎块越稳定。
tooltips.Speed of the simulation; below 1 gives s: 模拟的快慢；小于 1 为慢动作。驱动的速度仍按模拟时间的每秒计算。
tooltips.Preview is for trying things out; Final: 预览用于试效果；终稿按最快的碎块所需的子步烘焙。
tooltips.Raise the substeps to the suggested valu: 建议值更高时把子步提高到建议值，很快的碎块就不容易穿过薄的碎块。
tooltips.Use the substeps below as they are; quic: 按下面设定的子步烘焙，速度快。
